definitions.explanation: One of the three main categories of keigo (polite language) in Japanese. Honorific language elevates the actions or state of the person being spoken about, showing respect toward them.

examples.japanese: {尊敬語|そんけいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
「⟦いらっしゃる→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{尊敬語|そんけいご}です。
⟦{目上|めうえ}→目上：03804_meue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尊敬語|そんけいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{正|ただ}しく⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ようにしましょう。
examples.english: Let's learn to use honorific language correctly when speaking to superiors.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the three categories of ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧ (polite language): {尊敬語|そんけいご} (honorific — elevates others), ⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧ (humble — lowers yourself), and ⟦{丁寧語|ていねいご}→丁寧語：15824_teineigo⟧ (polite — です/ます forms). {尊敬語|そんけいご} is used when referring to the actions of someone you respect.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尊敬語|そんけいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use honorific language)
- {尊敬語|そんけいご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧ (honorific verbs)
- {尊敬語|そんけいご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧ (honorific and humble language)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧: humble language — lowers the speaker's actions
- ⟦{丁寧語|ていねいご}→丁寧語：15824_teineigo⟧: polite language — です/ます style
- ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧: polite/honorific language — the umbrella term for all three
